subject: Proposal: 16→32 Reserved GPUs + Revised Hourly Rate — BluePeak Renewal
messages:
From: Elena Russo <elena@bluepeak.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Singh <samir@bluepeak.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal discussion — upgrade request

Hi Karthik,

Quick note as we're approaching our March renewal: BluePeak currently runs a 16-GPU reserved pool with Redwood. Over Q1 we've seen production demand spike and our forecasting shows sustained higher utilization — we want to move to a 32-GPU reserved pool locked in at renewal.

Key asks:
- Upgrade committed pool from 16→32 GPUs at renewal date (2027-03-01).
- Revised per-hour reserved rate for the 32-GPU pool; please indicate the per-GPU/hour price and the blended hourly cost for the pool.
- Throughput/latency guarantee for peak windows (we operate heavy inference batches 08:00–20:00 PST).
- Clear change-in-term language and impact on prorated billing for the renewal month.

I've attached a short doc with our desired start date and usage profile (BLP-Renewal-Requirements.xlsx). Happy to hop on a call with your team this week to align.

Thanks —
Elena Russo
Head of Platform Engineering, BluePeak Analytics
elena@bluepeak.ai
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: BLP-Renewal-Requirements.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Russo <elena@bluepeak.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — upgrade request

Elena — thanks for the heads up and the profile. We're able to support the 16→32 upgrade at renewal; below is an initial commercial outline for discussion:

Summary proposal (initial):
- Committed pool: 32 x A100-equivalent GPUs (reserved capacity)
- Term: 12 months from 2027-03-01
- Hourly reserved rate (blended): $13.75 / GPU-hour (this reflects a volume discount vs current 16-GPU rate)
- Throughput SLO: baseline per-GPU throughput equivalent to 2.2k tokens/sec steady-state; for the pool we can guarantee an aggregate 44k tokens/sec during 08:00–20:00 PST with automated burst policies.
- Billing: prorated for partial months; one-time amendment fee waived if signed within 30 days.

I'm attaching our dedicated pricing sheet and a first-draft amendment (pricing + terms). Marissa — please help me validate the amendment language (SLA and prorating). Dev — can you confirm the throughput numbers and whether we should propose an explicit p99 latency SLO or a throughput-based guarantee?

If this looks reasonable, I can send a revised amendment for signature (DocuSign). Would you be available for a 30-minute call Thursday 14th 9am PST?

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | (650) 555-0124

Attachments: redwood_pricing_dedicated_q1-2027.pdf, BLP-Amendment-16to32-terms-v1.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Renewal discussion — upgrade request

Looping you both in — forwarding Elena's note and the usage sheet. High level: BluePeak wants to double their pool to 32 GPUs at renewal and is expecting aggressive throughput in business hours.

Marissa — key commercial items I want us to consider: tighter SLO language for throughput/availability, whether we can include a short-term price protection (90 days) on per-GPU rate, and flex to provide a modest introductory credit for the first month.

Dev — any quick observations on the feasibility of the 44k tokens/sec aggregate guarantee with our autoscaling/burst rules? Also, do we need to recommend quantization or caching configs to meet their cost targets?

Thanks — K

Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal discussion — upgrade request (throughput notes)

Short notes from infra/encoding side:
- 44k tokens/sec aggregate is achievable if workload mixes remain similar to the profile (long-running batches plus interactive requests). That assumes continuous batching and KV-cache reuse across requests.
- p99 latency SLO is brittle for mixed workloads; recommend a throughput guarantee for business hours with an SLA credit tied to sustained shortfall (e.g., if aggregate throughput drops >20% for 6 consecutive hours).
- Suggested contractual language: "Redwood will maintain an aggregate pool throughput capacity of X tokens/sec during 08:00–20:00 PST, with a service credit threshold if aggregate capacity is not met for a defined period."
- Ops ask: allow Redwood to configure automatic burst policies and ephemeral burst capacity (up to +8 GPUs) for 60-min windows to handle flash events; billing for burst would be at a pre-agreed lower overage rate.

I'll draft suggested SLA clause if Marissa gives the green light.

— Dev
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Russo <elena@bluepeak.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Samir Singh <samir@bluepeak.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Revised amendment and pricing — BluePeak renewal (16→32)

Elena — thanks for the call last week. We've incorporated the technical and commercial feedback and produced a revised amendment. Highlights:

- Committed pool: 32 x A100-equivalent GPUs, term 12 months starting 2027-03-01.
- Blended hourly reserved rate: $12.95 / GPU-hour (revised from the initial $13.75 — includes a first-month credit equivalent to one week of pool hours).
- Throughput guarantee: aggregate 42,000 tokens/sec guaranteed during 08:00–20:00 PST. Service credit if aggregate throughput drops below 80% of this value for >4 consecutive hours in a billing period.
- Burst policy: Redwood may enable ephemeral burst capacity up to +6 GPUs for up to 60 minutes; overage billed at $22 / GPU-hour.
- Prorating: partial-month prorate for both increases and decreases; amendment includes example calculation.

Attached: BLP-Amendment-16to32-terms-v2.docx (redlines included) and our pricing sheet. If you can confirm commercial approval I will generate DocuSign and schedule provisioning for 2027-03-01.

Call to action: please confirm if BluePeak can sign the amendment by 2027-02-10 to lock the revised blended rate and the first-month credit.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Attachments: BLP-Amendment-16to32-terms-v2.docx, redwood_pricing_dedicated_q1-2027.pdf
